admin.error.incompleteSpecies: The national catalog requires a name, group and sourced Kyrgyzstan link. An empty draft cannot be published.
admin.title: Editor dashboard
admin.notPublished: Drafts do not change the official catalog. Changes have not been published.
admin.noAuth: The /admin address has no authentication; this is a local tool, not a server CMS.
admin.saved: Draft saved locally. It has not been published.
admin.valid: Structure and export conditions checked. An editor must verify the claims themselves.
admin.exported: Export file prepared. Replace the project source and run checks before publishing.
admin.idHint: Unique slug: Latin letters, digits and hyphens.
admin.verified: Scientific entry reviewed by an editor
admin.reviewHint: Do not mark an entry reviewed without independent editorial work. A URL alone does not confirm a scientific fact.
admin.noMatches: No matching entries. Change the search or filters.
admin.sourceRequiredHint: Run npm run dev:admin to edit. The catalogue loads from repository files.
admin.confirmDelete: Delete the local entry “{name}”? The official catalog stays unchanged. Restore it from the original import or previous draft.
admin.confirmImport: A new import will replace the current working document. Export any changes you need first. Continue?
admin.confirmReset: Reload catalogue from repository files? Unsaved edits are lost; the saved file draft is retained.
admin.confirmRestore: Replace the current document with the previous saved draft?
admin.noSources: Add publications in the Sources tab first.
admin.populationRules: Exact requires a documented complete count. A known estimate needs territory, year, unit, sources and separate approval. Its type does not establish its validity.
admin.unknownPopulation: Numeric fields for unknown are null. Unknown does not equal zero.
admin.populationDiscard: Incompatible numbers will be cleared to null. Save a draft or export values you need before changing. Continue?
admin.supportsHint: Select only claims actually supported by the publication. A field path is a link, not evidence by itself.
admin.versionReviewed: I read this version and checked its URL
admin.sourceHint: Do not guess translation URLs. Unconfirmed language versions block export. Leave unknown information empty.
admin.photoRules: A local photo is only a preview. It is not sent to a server; loading does not confirm its rights. Original pixels are unchanged.
admin.dragPhoto: Photo: drag with a pointer or use the sliders
admin.dragHint: Drag with a mouse or touch. Sliders are keyboard accessible.
admin.imageUnavailable: Photo unavailable. Choose a file for local preview.
admin.zoomWarning: This zoom may expose insufficient detail: original resolution is not increased.
admin.author: Photo author
admin.licenseReviewed: I manually checked rights and usage conditions
admin.caption: Photo caption
admin.filePrepared: This file has been placed at the stated project path. The generator will check its existence and SHA-256.
admin.filePendingHint: File is not prepared for publication. Blob URLs are not exported; choose the file again after reloading.
admin.replacePhotoHint: The SHA-256 differs. Author, license, path and compositions will be reset. Save a draft you need first.
admin.removePhotoHint: Remove only this image metadata from the local draft? The original file stays in the project.
admin.noPhotos: This species has no images yet.
admin.previewHint: This is a local draft preview. Canvas always uses detail. Card and lesson may have separate compositions; the public site applies them after export and publication.
admin.lessonFrameHint: Without a lesson composition, the whole photo is shown. Set lesson composition to enable a 4:3 crop.
admin.step.1: Run npm run dev:admin; the catalogue loads from the repository.
admin.step.2: Edit existing records or add a new draft.
admin.step.3: Save the draft separately; export its materials if needed.
admin.step.4: Run server validation and review the changes.
admin.step.5: Confirm apply to source and check the local website.
admin.step.6: Review git diff and tests. Commit, push and Vercel updates are manual.
admin.filesGuide: Source: data/species.source.json. Do not independently edit generated files.
admin.staticGuide: The working editor is disabled in production. Local apply does not deploy anything.
admin.dependenciesGuide: Editing requires Node.js; new photos also require Python and Pillow.
admin.error.jsonSize: JSON too large: up to 2 MiB allowed.
admin.error.schema: Invalid source JSON schema; import was not performed.
admin.error.sourceRequired: Import the full source JSON first.
admin.error.populationApproval: Exporting a known population requires separate approval of the estimate.
admin.error.filePending: The local file approved for publication has not been prepared in the project.
admin.error.export: Export blocked. Fix structure and publication conditions below.
admin.error.draft: Local draft is damaged. It was not loaded; the source file is unchanged.
admin.error.storage: Draft not saved: storage unavailable or full. Data remains in tab memory; export it before closing.
admin.error.publicCatalog: Published catalog unavailable. You can import source JSON manually.
admin.error.imageSize: Maximum file size is 20 MiB and image size is 40 megapixels.
admin.error.imageFormat: Use a genuine JPEG, PNG or WebP with a matching extension. SVG and other formats are not accepted.
admin.error.imageDecode: The photo cannot be decoded. Choose another file.
admin.error.sessionSize: Local previews are limited to 60 MiB. Remove unneeded previews or reload the editor after saving.
admin.files.draftSaved: Draft saved in project files. The catalogue is unchanged.
admin.files.confirmApply: Apply changes to {count} records? Project files will change; nothing will be deployed.
admin.files.confirmRestore: Replace the working copy with this draft? The source catalogue stays unchanged. Save any edits you need first.
admin.files.confirmMigrate: Save a separate copy in data/drafts/migrations? Neither the catalogue nor browser data is replaced. Previously unsaved image files cannot be recovered.
admin.files.migrated: Legacy draft copied separately; catalogue and browser data were retained.
admin.files.draftRestored: Draft and materials restored separately from the catalogue.
admin.files.changedDuringCheck: Edits changed during validation. Validate again.
admin.files.valid: Server validation passed. Review the changes before applying.
admin.files.applied: Changes applied to project files. They have not been sent to GitHub or the website.
admin.files.localNotice: Local file editor. Saving a draft and applying it to the catalogue are separate operations. Git and Vercel are updated manually.
admin.files.notPushed: Files changed locally. No Git commit, push or website deployment was performed.
admin.files.taxonName: Exact scientific identification in the image
admin.files.taxonConfirmed: I checked that the pictured taxon matches this record.
admin.files.rightsConfirmed: I checked the original source, author and redistribution permission.
admin.error.localServer: Local API unavailable. Run npm run dev:admin and open 127.0.0.1.
admin.error.conflict: Source files changed in another process. Export your draft and reload the catalogue; overwrite was refused.
admin.error.draftConflict: The file draft changed in another window. Keep an export and open the latest copy.
admin.error.archive: Archive and document metadata changes are forbidden.
admin.error.locked: Another process is saving files. Try again shortly.
admin.error.imagePipeline: Image processing failed. Check the file and Python/Pillow installation in README.
admin.error.imageIntegrity: Image bytes, checksum or dimensions do not match.
admin.error.imageRights: A new image requires confirmed rights and a permitted licence without NC/ND.
admin.error.imageEvidence: Confirm exact taxon identification and rights; provide the original file URL.
admin.error.busy: Too many pending previews. Wait or restart the editor.
admin.error.validation: Generators rejected the changes. Fix the listed errors.
admin.error.recovery: An interrupted file transaction requires recovery. Keep data/drafts/transactions backups and follow README before applying again.
admin.error.confirmation: Explicit confirmation of the reviewed changes is required.
admin.error.origin: Request rejected: only the local 127.0.0.1 editor is allowed.
admin.error.disk: Insufficient disk space. No files are deleted automatically.
admin.error.server: Operation failed. Check the terminal and saved files.
admin.files.correctEvidence: Document a metadata correction for the existing image
admin.files.legacyOpened: Legacy working copy opened. Apply is blocked if the source has changed. Reselect any lost image files.
